name: Elk King
description: A petty Istfellian king whose crown of braided iron elk antlers Bjorn claims after killing him.

timeline.summary: Ranar and Bjorn cut through the Elk King's guard and Bjorn kills the Elk King, taking his crown.
timeline.quote: He plunged his dagger into the spirit's neck and levered him to the floor.

relations.note: Bjorn, Egon in disguise, kills the Elk King.
relations.quote: He plunged his dagger into the spirit's neck and levered him to the floor.
